blocks.text: Loop of Henle aur collecting duct se pani wapas lene ke liye nephrons apne gird ke mayi mein namak (NaCl) ki zyada miqdar banate aur qaim rakhte hain. Yeh counter-current mechanism se hota hai, jise yeh naam is liye mila ke mayi loop ki aik limb mein neeche aur doosri mein oopar ulti simt behta hai.

items: Descending limb pani ke liye khuli (permeable) magar namak ke liye band hai. Filtrate neeche behta hai to pani osmosis se bahar ke namkeen mayi mein chala jata hai.

Ascending limb pani ke liye band (impermeable) hai magar sodium ions ko active transport se filtrate se bahar nikalti hai; chloride ions un ke peeche jate hain. Is se gird ke mayi mein namak zyada rehta hai.
Jab peshab is namkeen mayi ke beech collecting duct mein neeche jata hai to pani osmosis se bahar nikal kar vasa recta ke zariye khoon mein chala jata hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: nephron par number wale qadam: 1 glomerulus se capsule mein zyada dabao par filtration; 2 reabsorption, zyada tar proximal tubule mein, glucose, amino acids, namak aur taqreeban 75% pani ki; 3 distal tubule mein H+, NH4+, K+ aur dawaon ka secretion. Medulla gehrai ke saath zyada namkeen dikhaya gaya; descending limb se pani nikalta, ascending limb se Na+ bahar pump hota, aur collecting duct se pani nikalta hai. Daen: ADH aur aldosterone ke flow charts.
blocks.caption: Counter-current mechanism: medulla gehrai ke saath zyada namkeen (topic 14.2.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Peshab teen qadmon mein banta hai. Filtration: efferent arteriole afferent se tang hai, is liye glomerulus mein dabao zyada rehta aur pani, urea, glucose, amino acids, vitamins aur namak ko Bowman's capsule mein dhakelta hai, plasma ka taqreeban paanchwan hissa, jabke proteins aur cells khoon mein rehte hain. Reabsorption: zyada tar mufeed cheezein proximal tubule mein wapas jati hain; descending limb pani nikalne deti, ascending limb namak bahar pump karti, aur distal tubule aur collecting duct mazeed wapas lete hain. Secretion: distal tubule H+, NH4+, K+ aur dawayein shamil karta hai. Loop se bana namkeen medulla collecting duct se pani kheenchta hai, zyada jab ADH duct ko pani ke liye khula (permeable) kar de; aldosterone distal tubule aur duct se Na+ wapas lene par majboor karta aur pani us ke peeche jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar tamam nephrons mein loops of Henle na hon to kaisa peshab banega, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Patla peshab: loops ke baghair namkeen medulla nahi banta, is liye collecting ducts se pani kheench kar peshab gaarha nahi kiya ja sakta.

items: Descending limb: pani bahar, namak andar. Ascending limb: Na+ bahar pump (Cl- peeche), pani andar. Namkeen medulla collecting duct se pani kheench kar vasa recta mein bhejta hai.
